difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism admitting a relatively very ample invertible sheaf is separated. The proof uses that separatedness is local on the base, that an immersion is separated, and that locally the morphism factors through an immersion into the homogeneous spectrum of a graded ring, which is separated.
